clues.text: This coaster reaches a top speed of 55 mph and stands 91 feet tall without featuring any inversions.
Designed by Curtis D. Summers, this ride officially opened to park guests in 1986.
This attraction is located in Northern California, entertaining visitors in the city of Santa Clara.
This wooden roller coaster delivers a traditional ride experience at California's Great America.
The coaster shares its name with a massive North American subspecies of brown bear.

evidence.quote: The Grizzly is a wooden roller coaster located at California's Great America  in Santa Clara, California.
